charts.title: Going for it on 4th-and-short
charts.subtitle: Share of 4th-and-1 or 2 plays where the offense went for it instead of kicking. Quarters 1-3, score within one possession, regular season
charts.hook: On 4th-and-short with the game close, teams went for it 22% of the time in 1999. In 2026: 55%.

charts.title: Run vs. pass: how often the NFL drops back
charts.subtitle: Share of offensive plays that were dropbacks (passes, sacks, scrambles), regular season
charts.hook: On early downs with the game in doubt, offenses dropped back 52% of the time in 1999. In 2026 it is 54%; the peak was 55% in 2020.

charts.title: The kickoff return is back
charts.subtitle: What happens on a regular-season kickoff, 1999 to today
charts.hook: In 1999, 87% of kickoffs were returned. By 2023 it was 23%. In 2026: 84%.

charts.title: The passing-yards race, 1999 to today
charts.subtitle: Cumulative regular-season passing yards since 1999, top 12 after each season
charts.hook: T.Brady leads everyone who has thrown a pass since 1999 with 89,216 yards (through 2026).

charts.title: Win-probability rollercoaster of the week
charts.subtitle: Week 6, 2026: Pittsburgh Steelers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers (2026-10-18). Final PIT 26 - TB 19.
charts.hook: Week 6: Tampa Bay Buccaneers had a 91% chance of winning in the third quarter and lost. Final PIT 26 - TB 19.
